newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian FIS welcomes leader's release.
newsitem.headline: Algerian FIS welcomes leader's release.

text.p: Algeria's radical Islamic Salvation Front (FIS) on Tuesday welcomed as a "positive act" the release of its leader Abassi Madani by Algerian authorities.

A statement from FIS headquarters in Europe, received in Paris, described the release as: "a positive act by President Liamine Zeroual and a definite and effective contribution to solving the crisis and returning to peace and stability."

The statement called for the release of Madani's deputy, Ali Belhadj, as well as that of "all the political prisoners, in order to prepare a healthy and favourable climate to start to seek an overall and just political solution which will allow the return of the effective sovereignty of the Algerian people".
The statement said Madani, sentenced to 12 years imprisonment in 1992, was returning to his family "and to the service of the cause of his people with his head held high and full of dignity".
